ability.name: Loontouched
ability.effect: If this unit is not a **^^Wizard^^**, it has **^^Wizard (1)^^**. Otherwise, add 1 to casting rolls for this unit.

ability.name: The Clammy Hand
ability.effect: Each time a friendly **^^Gloomspite Gitz^^** unit wholly within 12" of this unit uses the ‘Rally’ command, you can make 3 additional rally rolls of D6.

ability.name: Fight Another Day
ability.effect: If this unit is in combat, roll a dice. On a 3+, this unit can immediately use the ‘Retreat’ ability as if it were your movement phase without any mortal damage being inflicted on it.
